## 5. Deep Learning for Robotics (Diffusion Policies, ACT, VLAs)

::: {tbl-colwidths="[14,22,12,52]"}

| **Symbol**                                                           | **Definition**                       | **Unit**      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
|:---------------------------------------------------------------------|:-------------------------------------|:--------------|:-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$\pi_\theta(\mathbf{a} \mid \mathbf{o})$**                         | **Parameterized Neural Policy**      | Distribution  | Deep policy network parameterized by weights $\theta$ (italic), mapping observation tensors to action distributions.                                                                                                                           |
| **$\mathbf{o}_t$**                                                   | **Multimodal Observation**           | Mixed         | Synchronized tokenized sensor packet (RGB images, depth latents, joint encoders, tactile arrays).                                                                                                                                              |
| **$\mathbf{a}_t \in \mathcal{A}$**                                   | **Cognitive Policy Action**          | Normalized    | Unprivileged action emitted by neural policy $\pi_\theta$ (normalized joint delta, target pose, or gripper command).                                                                                                                           |
| **$\mathbf{A}_{t:t+H}$**                                             | **Action Chunk Trajectory**          | Tensor        | Contiguous horizon sequence $[\mathbf{a}_t, \mathbf{a}_{t+1}, \dots, \mathbf{a}_{t+H-1}] \in \mathbb{R}^{H \times d_a}$ predicted in a single forward pass, with horizon $H$ (defined earlier).                                                |
| **$K$**                                                              | **Ensembling Window Length**         | Time steps    | Number of overlapping past chunks blended in receding horizon execution ($K \le H$).                                                                                                                                                           |
| **$N_{\text{eval}}$**                                                | **Decoder Evaluation Count**         | Count         | Dependent forward passes of a generative action head per chunk (denoising or ODE-solver steps); distinct from the ensembling window $K$ and the step index $k$.                                                                                |
| **$w_i$**                                                            | **Temporal Ensembling Weight**       | Scalar        | Exponential decay weighting factor $w_i = \exp(-m \cdot i)$ applied to chunk predictions at offset $i$; the decay rate $m$ is local to this weight.                                                                                            |
| **$\mathbf{z} \in \mathbb{R}^d$**                                    | **Latent Style / State Embedding**   | Dimensionless | Compressed semantic representation or CVAE latent style variable in ACT policies.                                                                                                                                                              |
| **$\bar{\alpha}_k$**                                                 | **Diffusion Schedule Parameter**     | $[0, 1]$      | Cumulative noise variance schedule parameter $\bar{\alpha}_k = \prod_{s=1}^k (1 - \beta_s)$ at diffusion step $k$.                                                                                                                             |
| **$\boldsymbol{\epsilon} \sim \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{0}, \mathbf{I})$** | **Diffusion Gaussian Noise**         | Tensor        | Standard normal Gaussian noise corrupted onto clean action trajectories.                                                                                                                                                                       |
| **$\boldsymbol{\epsilon}_\theta(\mathbf{o}, \mathbf{A}^k, k)$**      | **Noise Prediction Network**         | Tensor        | Neural network predicting added noise in Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM).                                                                                                                                                      |
| **$\mathcal{L}_{\text{diff}}(\theta)$**                              | **Diffusion Matching Loss**          | Scalar        | Mean-squared error objective: $\mathbb{E}[\lVert \boldsymbol{\epsilon} - \boldsymbol{\epsilon}_\theta(\mathbf{o}_t, \mathbf{A}_t^k, k) \rVert^2]$ optimized across denoising steps.                                                            |
| **$\mathcal{L}_{\text{ACT}}(\theta, \phi)$**                         | **ACT Variational Objective**        | Scalar        | CVAE objective combining trajectory reconstruction $\mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}}$ with latent KL-regularization $\beta D_{\text{KL}}$.                                                                                                           |
| **$q_\phi(\mathbf{z} \mid \mathbf{o}, \mathbf{A})$**                 | **CVAE Recognition Encoder**         | Distribution  | Variational encoder in Action Chunking with Transformers parameterizing latent distribution $\mathcal{N}(\boldsymbol{\mu}, \boldsymbol{\Sigma})$; $\phi$ here is the encoder's parameter set.                                                  |
| **$t_{\text{div}}$**                                                 | **Divergence Instant**               | $\text{s}$    | Time at which the autonomous policy's rollout begins to leave its supported states before a takeover; the start of the interval excluded from imitation targets.                                                                               |
| **$\epsilon$**                                                       | **Single-Step Imitation Error**      | $[0, 1]$      | Bounded probability of an unforced policy error during an individual execution step; bold $\boldsymbol{\epsilon}$ is diffusion noise, and other error bounds carry a subscript ($\epsilon_{\text{track}}$).                                    |
| **$\mathcal{O}(T^2 \epsilon)$**                                      | **Compounding Covariate Drift**      | Error bound   | Quadratic compounding trajectory drift under open-loop behavioral cloning rollouts lasting $T$ control steps.                                                                                                                                  |
| **$\mathbf{W}_{\text{patch}}, \mathbf{E}_{\text{pos}}$**             | **ViT Projection & Positional Bias** | Matrix        | Convolutional/linear patch projection matrix and spatial coordinate position embedding tensors.                                                                                                                                                |
| **$\mathbf{Z}$**                                                     | **Multimodal Fused Token Stream**    | Tensor        | Concatenated token sequence $[\mathbf{z}_{\text{vision}}, \mathbf{z}_{\text{text}}, \mathbf{z}_{\text{proprio}}]$ ingested by embodied transformer backbones.                                                                                  |
| **$M_{\text{KV}}$**                                                  | **Transformer KV-Cache Footprint**   | bytes         | Autoregressive key-value cache memory footprint at the embodied batch size $B = 1$ ($2 \times N_L \times d \times S \times s_{\text{elem}}$ with full multi-head attention).                                                                   |
| **$\mathcal{I}_{\text{intent}}$**                                    | **Intent Lease**                     | Tuple         | $(\mathcal{G}_{\text{goal}}, [t_{\text{adm}}, t_{\text{intent\_exp}}], \mathbf{w}_{\max})$: the admitted goal set, its validity interval, and its effort ceilings; it names a target, never a path. Calligraphic $\mathcal{L}$ stays the loss. |
| **$t_{\text{intent\_exp}}$**                                         | **Intent-Lease Expiry**              | $\text{s}$    | $t_{\text{intent\_exp}} = \min(t_0 + \tau_{\text{ev}},\, t_{\text{adm}} + T_{\text{admin}},\, t_{\text{deadline,stop}})$, where $t_{\text{deadline,stop}}$ is the instant by which a stop must begin; see the lease table above.               |
| **$\tau_{\text{ev}}$**                                               | **Evidence Horizon**                 | $\text{ms}$   | Time for which a target estimate stays within its task tolerance without fresh evidence.                                                                                                                                                       |

:::

## 6. Embedded Systems, Silicon Real-Time, Thermal, and Hardware Safety

Response-time analysis keeps the Liu–Layland letters of its literature, but only inside that model and only with a task index $i$, $j$, or $k$: $C_i$ (worst-case execution time), $B_i$ (blocking), $I_i$ (interference), $J_i$ (release jitter), $T_i$ (period), $R_i$ (worst-case response time), and $D_i$ (relative deadline, which is $T_{\text{deadline}}$ of task $i$ in the series' terms), as in $R_i = C_i + B_i + I_i \le D_i$. Outside that model these letters keep their table meanings.

::: {tbl-colwidths="[14,22,12,52]"}

| **Symbol**                            | **Definition**                   | **Unit**                      | **Notes**                                                                                                                                                                       |
|:--------------------------------------|:---------------------------------|:------------------------------|:--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **$L_{\text{bus}}, R_{\text{bus}}$**  | **Power Rail Inductance / ESR**  | $\mu\text{H}, \text{m}\Omega$ | Parasitic power wiring harness inductance and Equivalent Series Resistance feeding inverters.                                                                                   |
| **$C_{\text{bus}}$**                  | **DC Bus Bulk Capacitance**      | $\mu\text{F}$                 | Inverter decoupling capacitor bank buffering transient inductive voltage collapse.                                                                                              |
| **$t_{\text{vulnerable}}$**           | **Seqlock Vulnerable Interval**  | $\mu\text{s}$                 | Race window ($t_{\text{write}} + t_{\text{read}}$) during lock-free inter-processor shared SRAM exchanges.                                                                      |
| **$p_{\text{retry}}$**                | **Seqlock Retry Probability**    | Dimensionless                 | Probability $t_{\text{vulnerable}} / T_{\text{writer}}$, for writer period $T_{\text{writer}}$, that a reader thread observes torn telemetry and must retry.                    |
| **$t_{\text{queue}}$**                | **Memory Bus Queue Delay**       | $\text{ms}$                   | Contention latency $\sum_k D_{\text{vol},k} / \text{BW}_{\text{peak}} + N_{\text{conflict}} t_{\text{penalty}}$ across shared SoC crossbars.                                    |
| **$N_{\text{conflict}}$**             | **Interconnect Port Conflicts**  | Count                         | Number of simultaneous DMA / GPU / CPU memory channel access collisions.                                                                                                        |
| **$\Delta t_{\text{fresh}}$**         | **Telemetry Freshness Bound**    | $\text{ms}$                   | Maximum allowable age of sensor telemetry before an interlock trips: $\Delta t_{\text{fresh}} \le e_{\max} / v_{\max}$.                                                         |
| **$t_{\text{watchdog}}$**             | **Hardware Watchdog Timeout**    | $\text{ms}$                   | Hardware timer period triggering fail-safe dynamic braking upon lost processor heartbeats.                                                                                      |
| **$t_{\text{NMI}}$**                  | **Non-Maskable Interrupt Time**  | $\mu\text{s}$                 | Deterministic hardware interrupt response time for motor overcurrent or gate-drive faults.                                                                                      |
| **$\theta_{\text{offset}}$**          | **Clock Offset**                 | $\mu\text{s}$                 | Offset of one clock from another, estimated from a timestamp exchange as $\theta_{\text{offset}} = [(t_2 - t_1) - (t_4 - t_3)]/2$; its one-way path delay is $T_{\text{prop}}$. |
| **$\delta_{\text{skew}}$**            | **Clock Synchronization Skew**   | $\text{ppm}, \mu\text{s/s}$   | Hardware crystal drift between the application processor and safety microcontroller clocks.                                                                                     |
| **$\sigma_{\text{jitter}}$**          | **Timing Jitter**                | $\mu\text{s}$                 | Standard deviation of a nominally periodic event's timing about its schedule.                                                                                                   |
| **$T_{\text{blackout}}$**             | **Synchronization Blackout**     | $\text{s}$                    | Interval during which a node receives no synchronization message and free-runs on its own clock.                                                                                |
| **$\Delta t_{\text{peak}}$**          | **Peak Inter-Node Phase Jitter** | $\mu\text{s}$                 | Cumulative timing uncertainty $\delta_{\text{skew}} T_{\text{blackout}} + \sigma_{\text{jitter}}$ during bus sync blackouts.                                                    |
| **$\mathcal{T}_{\text{trichotomy}}$** | **Trichotomy Monitor State**     | Enum                          | Three-valued real-time monitor evaluation: $\{\text{Known-True}, \text{Known-False}, \text{Unknown}\}$.                                                                         |

:::
